First call: weather_forecast_temperature(location="Boston", days=10). Then second: weather_forecast_humidity(location="Boston", days=10). Third: weather_forecast_precipitation(location="Rome", days=10).

So we need to make three calls. We'll do them sequentially. We'll start with temperature. Then humidity. Then precipitation.
